blocks.title: Reaction ka order
blocks.text: Kisi khas reactant ke lihaz se reaction ka order rate muadle mein us reactant ki concentration par lagaya hua exponent hai. Reaction A ke lihaz se order x aur B ke lihaz se order y ki hai, aur kul order x + y.

Order tai karta hai ke reactant concentration rate par kaise asar karti hai; ek reactant ke liye yeh bas rate muadle mein us ki concentration ki taqat hai. Reactions zero, pehle, doosre aur teesre order mein taqseem hoti hain, aur order mechanism ke bare mein qeemti maloomat deta hai. Ek reactant ke order aur kul order mein farq karna bohat aham hai. 2H2(g) + 2NO(g) se N2(g) + 2H2O(g) ke liye rate law rate = k [H2][NO]^2 hai: H2 ke lihaz se pehla order, NO ke lihaz se doosra order, aur kul teesra order (1 + 2 = 3).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Reaction ka order un sab exponents ka majmooa hai jin par rate muadle mein concentrations uthai gai hain. Yeh tajurbe se tai hone wali miqdar hai aur reaction ke muadle se nahi nikali ja sakti; rate muadle ke exponents ka majmooa balanced muadle ke coefficients ke majmooe ke barabar ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi.

blocks.prompt: Rate law se order kaise nikalta hai, aur specific rate constant kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Har reactant ka order rate law mein us ki concentration ki taqat hai, aur kul order un taqaton ka majmooa; rate = k [H2][NO]^2 ke liye orders 1, 2 aur kul 3 hain. Specific rate constant k rate law ka tanasub ka constant hai, jo har reactant concentration 1 mol dm-3 hone par rate ke barabar hai.

items: Reactant ke lihaz se order = rate law mein us ka exponent; kul order = exponents ka majmooa (rate = k [H2][NO]^2: 1, 2, kul 3); tajurbe se milta hai, muadle se nahi.
